overall: Script routes work: akleg statute/AAC print URLs, ltgov constitution, all five rule PDFs, LII, OPNS and the Appellate CMS were reached on probe and second citations. WebFetch is gated on every built or non-search URL. Problems: (1) the session-law row is still VERIFIED/WebFetch-ok, but the case-insensitive robots policy blocks /pdf/ on every route, so it should be BLOCKED. (2) Justia statutes' current edition uses unyeared URLs plus an article level the pattern omits. (3) Subsequent history: the S-case disposition appears only as 'Disposition Order' on the Docket tab, not on the summary page. (4) The regex misses prose 'section NN.NN.NNN of the Alaska Statutes' and 'section N of article X'. The short-form regex also catches Probate/CINA/Delinquency rules, which have no source row.
